the agency must safely discontinue use of the AI functionality.","source_section":"Section 4(a)(i)"}]}],"implementation_notes":"This memorandum rescinds M-24-10 and implements EO 14179. It applies to all executive branch agencies including independent regulatory agencies but excludes National Security Systems and Intelligence Community elements from high-impact AI requirements. Timelines range from 60 days (CAIO designation) to 365 days (minimum risk management implementation). Enforcement is internal to the executive branch with no civil or criminal penalties specified; discontinuation of non-compliant AI use is the primary sanction. The 'third_party_audit' label is applied conservatively as the independent reviewer must be within the agency.","confidence":0.92}
